Get Vertex Attribute on Network Object

Source: R/network.R
get_vertex_attribute.Rd

Gets a vertex attribute from an object of class network. This function simplifies the related function in the network package.

Usage

get_vertex_attribute(x, attrname)

Arguments

x

An object of class network.

attrname

The name of the attribute to get.

Value

Returns a vector of vertex attribute values for the attribute specified by attrname.

Details

This function is used in EpiModel workflows to query vertex attributes on an initialized empty network object (see network_initialize()).

Examples

nw <- network_initialize(100)
nw <- set_vertex_attribute(nw, "age", runif(100, 15, 65))
get_vertex_attribute(nw, "age")
